headline: MAS's Future of Finance Institute has begun operations with an AI focus
body: The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) announced that its Future of Finance Institute (FFI) has begun operations. The institute will initially focus on AI through three programmes, PathFin.ai, BuildFin.ai and SafeFin.ai, covering knowledge sharing, AI deployment and risk management, particularly for agentic AI. MAS has appointed Alan Lim as interim chief executive.
note: For banks and insurers, the institute is a new forum for AI adoption, and its agentic AI work builds on a safeguards framework MAS developed with industry partners.

evidence.text: The Future of Finance Institute (FFI) has begun operations, the Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) announced.
First announced in June 2026 , the institute will initially focus on AI adoption in financial services through three programmes covering knowledge sharing, AI deployment and risk management.

Its three programmes, PathFin.ai, BuildFin.ai and SafeFin.ai, will focus on sharing practical experience, developing tools and standards for AI deployment, and strengthening risk management practices, particularly for agentic AI.
The institute will also create Communities of Practice involving professionals from banking, insurance, capital markets, financial advisory and payments.
The programme will build on the Safeguards for Agentic Finance at Runtime (SAFR) framework , which MAS developed with industry partners.
MAS has appointed Alan Lim as FFI’s interim Chief Executive Officer.
